title: 芽苗齒輪
subject: a chunky honey-gold mechanical cogwheel with exactly six broad softly rounded teeth, viewed almost front-on but slightly three-quarter so the clay volume is visible. A single short sage-green two-leaf sprout grows from its warm-brown circular center, and one small coral-red rounded activation stud sits on the lower-right tooth. The wheel is the main solid silhouette and the sprout is its one clear natural detail. No planter, no extra gears, no loop arrow

mechanical_operations.note: Canvas resize/centering only; original shading and alpha retained. No drawing, thickening, outlines or shape edits.
